description: This PHP script is part of the TestLink open-source testing management tool. It generates detailed test suite reports, handles report data, and can produce spreadsheet exports. The file includes functions for initializing report data, building email configurations, creating spreadsheets, and managing access rights. It references several external classes and configuration files relevant to the TestLink project, such as 'testplan', 'common', 'displayMgr', and components for spreadsheet generation and configuration.

classes.name: TLSmarty
classes.description: A templating class used to handle Smarty templates for rendering reports.

classes.name: tlTestPlanMetrics
classes.description: A class managing metrics related to test plans, including retrieving status totals and execution time span.

classes.name: testplan
classes.description: Represents a test plan, providing methods for managing and retrieving test plan data.

classes.name: testproject
classes.description: Provides static methods for retrieving test project information.

classes.name: tlObject
classes.description: Utility class with static methods, such as getDBTables for database table names.

methods.name: buildMailCfg
methods.description: Constructs email configuration object for sending report summaries.

methods.name: initializeGui
methods.description: Initializes GUI-related data structures, manages report parameters, and sets up environment for report generation.

methods.name: createSpreadsheet
methods.description: Generates an Excel spreadsheet report based on current test suite data, including styling and data export.

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Checks if the user has rights to view or modify test plan metrics based on project and plan IDs.
